A row nested directly inside a cell keeps its visible text

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td><tr><td>Visible text</td></tr></td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
